1.

When peace like a river overflows my path, When waves of sorrow break over me, Whatever my lot, I can yet say: It is well, it is well with my soul.

C.

It is well with my soul; It is well, it is well with my soul.

2.

Though the enemy afflicts, though I bear the cross, I am secure in my Saviour, For He has done all for my eternal well-being And has shed His blood for my soul.

3.

My debt-bond (so the Lord assures me indeed), My debt-bond of sins and of lack, Is nailed to the cross, no more am I a slave! Praise the Lord, my ransomed soul!

4.

O Lord, I long to see what I believe, To see Thee in Thy great glory! Yea, soon Thou shalt come; then all shall be well with me, For in grace Thou hast redeemed my soul!
